scope: Frontend owner minimal panel-submit correction; SOURCE STOP; development evidence only
root_causes: Sequence-device input was redirected to use_item whenever an inventory item remained selected, including the reusable access_card after it was accepted.
A paper-installed console exposed local sequence editing before FINAL_CHECK, but did not show the existing exit_door start-check affordance or explain why submission remained unavailable.
Returning from the card reader with access_card selected caused the overview console click to use the card on r3_panel instead of opening its closeup.
changes: Sequence-device input always edits the validated local sequence draft, independent of selected inventory item.
A r3_panel overview click sends inspect when the public panel state is STRIP_INSERTED; the empty paper slot and all other overview objects retain existing selected-item semantics.
The console displays readiness instructions, without disclosing the puzzle answer.

When public exit state is CARD_ACCEPTED and exit_door exposes interact, an explicit console button uses that existing server affordance tool and arguments to start FINAL_CHECK while retaining the closeup and draft.
Submit remains disabled until the server provides submit_sequence, the draft has the required length and the sequence is not completed. Explicit use-item controls remain unchanged.
